title: Time Management
description: Advanced time management techniques including the Eisenhower matrix, Pomodoro technique, and energy-based scheduling.

modules.title: Module 1: Foundations
modules.summary: Learn the essentials of module 1 for Time Management.

content.text: Welcome to Lesson 1 of Time Management. In this lesson, you'll learn about Getting Started—a fundamental concept in Productivity.
Core Concept: Getting Started
Every great time management practitioner starts with understanding Getting Started. This lesson walks you through the key ideas, common mistakes, and a practical example you can try today.

content.title: Pro Tip
content.text: The most successful practitioners in Productivity always practice Getting Started before moving to more advanced topics.

content.title: Common Mistake
content.text: Beginners often rush through Getting Started without mastering the fundamentals. Take your time and build a solid foundation.

content.question: What is the main purpose of Getting Started in Time Management?
content.explanation: The goal of Getting Started is to build a solid foundation you can build on.

content.text: Apply it
Try applying Getting Started to a small project this week. Reflect on what worked and what needs more practice.
